actions: Author motif and all required sections/layers/intro/exit/stinger in editable session. AI full track only supplies candidate material; separately qualify any stems/MIDI extraction.

actions: Export aligned stems with same origin and explicit bars/tails. Example fixture:96BPM4/4 at48kHz gives30000samples/beat and960000samples/8bars. Check clicks/seams/phase/bleed and every stem combination.
expected_observations: Exact timebase and loop boundaries plus listening; numeric meter does not replace musical verdict.

actions: Import pinned format/normalize/compression/loop settings; create synchronized layers and explicit interactive transition table. Bind hysteresis and next-bar vs immediate death/pause policy.
expected_observations: Current engine probe confirms scheduling; stable prose/API assumptions not silently trusted.

actions: Exercise every allowed pair, late-bar request, repeated request during crossfade, long loop, pause/resume and cold decode. Verify no second layer set after return.
expected_observations: Transitions musically coherent and semantically correct; actual voice/decode/memory budgets documented.
